d:
Bahar ki milavat se bachna hai? to tyauhar par ghar ki bred se banaie ye halvaee jaisi mithaee — bilkul chhena rol jaisi! na ghi, na mehnat, na tamjhama. sirph 10 bred aur ₹100 men parivar ke lie taiyar karen aisi mithaee jise koee pahchan hi nahin paega ki ye bred se bani hai.
Is vidiyo men sikhenge:
10 bred se chhena rol jaisi spanji mithaee
bred ko parphekt rol karne ki stim trik
malaee, motichur laddu aur kesar dudh ki philing
bina mava-ghi, sirph ghar ki chizon se halvaee jaisa svad
Karva chauth, divali ya kisi bhi tyauhar ke lie parphekt — kam samay, kam kharch men.
